title: Marinara
notes: Can be stored in jars and refrigerated for up to one week.

steps: Heat a heavy bottom large pot on medium low flame.
Add a lug of olive oil and the diced onion with a pinch of sea salt.
Cook for about 10 minutes until translucent, taking good care not to burn it.
Stir in the minced garlic and let it infuse the oil for about 30 seconds.
Use your hands to crush the tomatoes as you add them to the pot with the onion and garlic, aiming for rustic chunks.
Add the bay leaf and 4 sprigs of basil, then bring everything to a gentle simmer.
Partially cover with a lid and cook down until reduced and thick to your liking, about an hour or so. Stir a few times to make sure the sugars from the tomatoes do not stick to the bottom.
After the sauce has reduced, season to taste with sea salt.
Discard the bay leaf and basil sprigs.
Finish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and the reserved fresh basil.
Serve with your favorite pasta or transfer to jars and refrigerate for up to one week.
